facts.fact: Data Center Dynamics reports that Seattle-based Chillmine signed an MoU with Energywise to develop solar-powered data centres in Zimbabwe expected to support AI Infrastructure-as-a-Service, with no sites or construction timelines disclosed.

ZWE.note: Planned solar park and MoU for data centres not yet built or in service; no supply in force, PUE or water figure stated.
Data centres are planned under an MoU, none in service, no tier or cloud region stated.
Planned data centres by a Seattle-based company, none in service; no nationally owned facility stated.
